description: Rename a Sentry project, change its slug, or change its platform. Returns the updated project. To change which teams can access a project, use add_team_to_project or remove_team_from_project.

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

anyOf.description: Sentry platform ID, e.g. `javascript-react`, `javascript-nextjs`, `node`, `python-django`, `apple-ios`, `android`, `dotnet`. Omit if unsure.

projectSlug.description: The project slug. In `org/project` notation, the part after the slash.

anyOf.description: The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.
New slug, unique in the organization. The project moves to the new slug.

name: update_project
title: Update Project
